item.title: Concession for Operation and Maintenance of Cafeteria at the NYPD Police Academy
item.description:
Police Department | Public Hearings and Meetings | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-08-10

NOTICE OF A JOINT PUBLIC HEARING of the Franchise and Concession Review Committee and the New York City Police Department (NYPD) to be held on 8/10/2026, at 255 Greenwich Street, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10007 commencing at 2:30 pm relative to:


INTENT TO AWARD as a concession a License Agreement (License) to Staten Island Bagel Café, Inc. (Concessionaire) for the operation and maintenance of the cafeteria at the NYPD Police Academy in College Point, Queens.

The License will provide for a period of four years with two (2) renewal options, each for a period of three (3) years.

Compensation to the City will be as follows: Concessionaire will pay to the City a monthly fee of 6% of gross receipts. Gross receipts shall mean all revenue derived from the sale of food, beverages, merchandise, catering services, and vending operations.

Written testimony may be submitted in advance of the hearing electronically to fcrc@mocs.nyc.gov. All written testimony can be submitted up until the close of the public hearing and will be distributed to the FCRC after the hearing.

item.title: Laboratory National Accreditation Renewal #1
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $135K | Vendor: ANSI National Accreditation Board LLC

The Police Laboratory is required by law to be accredited by an accrediting body. NYS Law Article 49B, of Executive Law 995, empowers the NYS Commission on Forensic Science to develop minimum standards and a program of accreditation for all public forensic laboratories in New York State. All NYS laboratories must demonstrate compliance with the standards of the American National Standards Institute National Accreditation Board (ANAB). ANAB accreditation is on a four-year cycle in this order annually; full assessment, off-site surveillance, mid-cycle on-site surveillance and finally off-site surveillance.

item.title: 05626P0001-Paid Detail Application and Software Platform
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-08-19

The New York City Police Department (NYPD) is seeking an appropriate vendor to create an electronic platform and application capable of supporting the scheduling of details, assignment, billing, and reporting, for uniformed members of the service who perform outside security-related services for participating clients of the Paid Detail program. Approximately 6,500 of the NYPD's uniformed members of the service are currently eligible to utilize the Paid Detail system to work at various locations. The successful vendor must have an existing platform and application that allows for substantial expansion in the number of the uniformed officers that could potentially participate in the Paid Detail program. Responses to this procurement must be submitted via PASSPort the City of New York's end-to-end digital procurement platform. To respond to a Released solicitation (RFx), log in to PASSPort, go to the RFx tab, and choose Browse My RFx Responses or Browse Public RFx to locate the RFx to which you're looking to respond. item.title: Maintenance Contract for Radeye/Nuke Instruments
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-06-29

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD) to enter into sole source negotiations with Thermo Eberline LLC  located at 27 Forge Parkway, Franklin, Massachusetts 02038.

The NYPD expects that Thermo Eberline LLC., will be awarded a contract to provide all maintenance services for all existing radeye/nuke instruments. These instruments will continue to assist the NYPDs Counterterrorism Division and their partners. NYPD believes that this maintenance  is provided exclusively by Thermo Eberline LLC.

Any vendor besides Thermo Eberline LLC that believes it can provide this maintenance and  to the existing instruments is invited to do so. To respond in PASSPort, please complete the Acknowledgement tab and submit a response in the Manage Responses tab. If you have questions about the details of the RFx, please submit them through the Discussion with Buyer tab and email Romilee Benavides at Romilee.benavides@nypd.org and contracts@nypd.org.

item.title: Drug Screening, Hair Analysis and Expert Witness Services
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $780K | Vendor: Psychemedics Corporation

Drug Screening, Hair Analysis and Expert Witness Services are imperative to the NYPDs ability to hire and maintain a qualified and high performing workforce. These critical ongoing services ensure the safety of NYPD members of service along with the well-being of the general public at large.  The current contract ended on 04/26/2025.  There is not enough time to get a new contractor in place without a gap in services.  NYPD has determined that the most suitable course of action is to pursue a negotiated acquisition extension for a two year period with the current vendor, Psychemedics Corporation.
